summary: Phase-2B end-to-end testing. Backend (7/7 pytest pass) — placement filtering, home_widgets CRUD with deprecated-type drop + 24 cap, admin disable propagation to home/realm pickers all work correctly. Realm picker rewiring is fully wired and works (toolbar has only Edit + Add-from-Library; picker opens, multi-select 2 widgets → 2 POSTs to /api/communities/realm/{id}/widgets returned 200). HOWEVER a CRITICAL routing bug breaks the entire /home Home-Widgets frontend feature: the actual /home route in App.js (line 84) renders HomeDashboard.jsx, NOT Home.jsx. HomeDashboard.jsx uses a legacy hardcoded WidgetLibrary modal and does NOT mount <HomeWidgets /> or RegistryWidgetPicker. The new HomeWidgets component is only rendered on /home/legacy — and even there it is rendered THREE TIMES because it is placed inside the Section sub-component (Home.jsx line 247) instead of next to the Section loop. None of the testids home-widgets-section, home-widgets-edit, home-widget-add-tile, registry-picker-home, home-widgets-save are reachable from /home as the review_request expects.

ui_bugs.issue: /home route is mapped to HomeDashboard.jsx (legacy WidgetLibrary), not Home.jsx. The new <HomeWidgets /> + RegistryWidgetPicker are therefore NEVER rendered on /home. The review_request testids (home-widgets-section, home-widgets-edit, home-widget-add-tile, registry-picker-home, home-widgets-save, home-widget-remove-*) are unreachable from /home for any user.

<HomeWidgets /> is placed INSIDE the Section sub-component (line 247) which is invoked once per category section (Featured/Recommended/Explore/Dive deeper). Result: 3 duplicate home-widgets-section nodes on the page (confirmed in test). Should be hoisted out of Section and rendered ONCE below the interest grid as the spec describes.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Add Home Widgets' on the actual /home page opens the legacy WidgetLibrary (For You Feed / Weather / Realms / Group Chats / Top News / Friend Activity / Notifications / Trending Sounds / Trending Posts / Suggested Friends / Recently Viewed / Bookmarks / Events / Top Communities) — these come from CATALOG_BY_TYPE inside HomeDashboard, not from /api/widgets/available?placement=home. The PATCH /api/home/widgets endpoint is therefore never hit from /home (it does work directly via curl, and works on /home/legacy).

test_results.frontend_home_widgets_section_on_/home: FAIL — 0 sections (route mounts HomeDashboard, not Home)

action_items: CRITICAL: Either change App.js to map /home to Home.jsx (and move HomeDashboard to /home/dashboard or replace it), OR mount the new HomeWidgets + RegistryWidgetPicker inside HomeDashboard.jsx and remove the legacy WidgetLibrary import/usage there.

HIGH: Move `<HomeWidgets />` in Home.jsx out of the Section component — it currently renders 3× because each Section call invokes it. Hoist it to the parent return (alongside Section/MediaBar) so exactly one home-widgets-section node exists.

After fix, retest: tftwo /home shows empty state, Manage Widgets → Add → picker (placement=home) → select top8+weather+notes → save → reload persists 3 widgets; stealth /home shows admin disabled-banner when any widget is disabled.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/home_widgets.py is clean and correct: ALLOWED_WIDGET_TYPES allow-list + custom-widget union, silent drop of unknown types, 24-cap enforced as HTTP 400, MongoDB _id excluded from response.

RegistryWidgetPicker.jsx properly uses two AbortController effects (preserves iter 44 fix), placement-aware testids, admin role check including viewer.is_admin/viewer.username==='stealth' fallback (note: same 'stealth' hard-code recommendation as iter 45 — non-blocking).

HomeWidgets.jsx local state model is correct (id-stamping with Date.now()+offset, remove by id, save replaces server array atomically). One observation: the component does NOT call load() after save — relying on the user reloading. Spec says 'Page refreshes after save'. Not currently happening; widgets remain in local state until next mount. Low priority.

RealmDetail.jsx correctly replaces hardcoded buttons with single 'Add from Library' inside realm-widgets-toolbar (verified: only 2 buttons in toolbar after edit toggle). POSTs fire one per selected item — works end-to-end.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase-2B is 100% green and stable. The only failing surface is FRONTEND /home routing/composition. Two-line fix likely: (a) App.js route change OR HomeDashboard integration, AND (b) hoist <HomeWidgets /> out of Section in Home.jsx. After fix, run the original review_request frontend scenarios (testids: home-widgets-section, home-widgets-edit, home-widget-add-tile, registry-picker-home, registry-picker-home-tile-{key}, registry-picker-home-save, home-widget-{id}, home-widgets-save, home-widget-remove-{id}, registry-picker-home-disabled-banner). Realm rewiring is already verified working — no need to retest unless RealmDetail.jsx is touched.
rca of the issue: Frontend Home-Widgets integration was implemented in Home.jsx, but Home.jsx is no longer the component mounted at /home in the current App.js — it was demoted to /home/legacy by an earlier change (HomeDashboard became the canonical /home). Additionally, the placement of <HomeWidgets /> on Home.jsx line 247 is inside the recursive Section sub-component, causing N-duplication. Mitigation: either remap /home to Home.jsx (and migrate HomeDashboard-specific UX into Home.jsx) or wire RegistryWidgetPicker+/api/home/widgets into HomeDashboard.jsx's existing widget-library + add/save flow.
